samples.identity: Qinghu WeChat Channels collection-video query skill 0.1.1
samples.behavior: Explicit user-authorized paid JSON-RPC API calls. Service-owned bearer token configuration, catalog caching, local result files, user-specified media uploads. No install hooks, hidden command execution or unrelated secret collection found.

samples.confidence_scope: Suspicious-grade unwanted bundleware; does not establish an unequivocal hostile malware family.
samples.identity: miniClickerLib .NET Framework 4.7.2 wrapper around native miniClicker/Birds installer
samples.behavior: Init reads embedded executable, writes it under temporary Clicker directory and launches it. Native installer writes Birds DLL and resolves Hatch. Fly loads Stork DLL and StartStork. Tweet fetches remote settings through WinINet, parses JSON and writes Chrome ExtensionInstallForcelist; Task Scheduler COM runs DLL exports through rundll32. No screenshot theft inferred from /os/ss URL. README discloses search redirection and delegates consent to the caller, but the implementation also installs forced browser policy and updater tasks.

corrections: Neutral resource/DLL API co-occurrence moved from hostile staging into embedded-resource capability; no activation relationship claimed.
Locale/environment API set moved from discovery objective to notable sysinfo capability.
Small versioned PE API co-occurrence moved from hostile fake-version claim to notable sysinfo capability; ordinary dotted-quad version pair moved to version scheme metadata.
Package install/add command text moved from process creation to package-manager references; global installs no longer described as project dependency additions.
Removed ascending 00..3f table as RC4 evidence; consumers now require canonical RC4 instruction evidence.
